about: Boucherville is a South Shore city in Montérégie, on the St. Lawrence immediately northeast of Longueuil. It grew from a seigneurial village into an affluent suburban city facing the Îles-de-Boucherville. The old village, a long riverfront, and the national park on the islands remain the public heart of the place. About 42,000 people live in Boucherville.
